retained_sources: ego velocity, pose and bounding box
rear vehicle pose and bounding box, with same-lane and behind tests
ego signal control request and original lamp or arm observation
outputs: longitudinal acceleration derived from retained velocity frames
signal first-observed frame, precedence and frame lead
rear vehicle same-lane, behind and surface-gap observations at event

source_observation_mapping.drv.stopped: speed <= 0.05 m/s diagnostic with source velocity
source_observation_mapping.sig.brake_lamp: signal request plus original observed lamp state; no inference from deceleration alone
source_observation_mapping.sig.hand_signal: retained observed arm-signal state; unsupported in current fixture
source_observation_mapping.drv.following: rear actor tracked in same lane behind ego

legal_boundaries: The law supplies no numeric threshold for suddenly or immediately.
A same-frame brake lamp does not establish that an appropriate signal was first given.
Appropriateness and actual rear-driver visibility require independent original-source review.
